episodes.synopsis: Lady Maria goes to study abroad in the Kingdom of Rubini to find her future husband.
episodes.title: How I Searched for a Promising Catch

episodes.synopsis: Renato apologizes profusely to Maria, who learns the truth about his engagement to Aida.

episodes.synopsis: After Prince Renato’s declaration, Maria faces a crucial moment: meeting her in-laws.
episodes.title: How I Trained to Become a Lady

episodes.synopsis: Maria is approached by Renato's cousin Ireneo, a notorious playboy.
episodes.title: How the One That Got Away Was Troubled

episodes.synopsis: Maria runs into trouble on the road home to the Kingdom of Muro.
episodes.title: How the One That Got Away Visited Home

episodes.synopsis: During her trip home, Maria worries how her family will react to her engagement to Prince Renato.
episodes.title: How the One That Got Away Fought with Her Father

episodes.synopsis: On her way back to Rubini, Maria checks in on Navarro village.

episodes.title: The Secret Date of the One That Got Away

episodes.synopsis: With their own engagement soon to be announced, Maria and Renato wonder how to get Aida and Placido together.
episodes.title: The One Who Got Away Plays Cupid

episodes.title: The One Who Got Away Prepares For a Ball

episodes.synopsis: Maria feels guilty about Ireneo not being invited to the ball and brings him a peach tart.
episodes.title: The One That Got Away Gets Dragged Into Romantic Trouble

episodes.synopsis: The dust settles, and the ball finally begins.
episodes.title: How I Punched My Way into Marrying a Prince
